explanation: Job 2 received complete demand/provenance inputs but its observed output failed to preserve stipulated fields and provenance. The coverage and priorities retain record_id and need, but omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight for all demand records despite the criterion requiring those fields to be preserved. The priorities also report upstream_rank as 0 for every record even though the evidence_sources input provides deterministic ranks 1 through 8, so provenance rank was not preserved. The supplied evidence does not name internal functions, so function-level localization is unsupported.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs include demand_score, need, record_id, source_id, and source_weight for records n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Job 2 output coverage entries include only capability_id, coverage, need, and record_id, omitting demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
Job 2 output priorities entries omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight and set upstream_rank: 0 for every record.
Job 2 input evidence_sources provides ranks 1 through 8 for source IDs s01 through s08, but those ranks are not preserved in the observed priorities.
